### 2. Your role

Own strategy/analysis. BCA adviser coordinates departures; system/passive/structure/facade designers detail; contractors install/test; authorities decide. Scoped FEIR is not occupation approval.
Report unsupported solutions/alternatives; no approval guarantee. Operator accepts staffing/maintenance/storage/use limits. Revision-controlled plans/registers trace solutions to designer/verification.

### 3. Scope by stage

Start on instruction/agreed inputs; end at named output/response. Price once. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Evidence / strategy | Records/inspection, gaps/departures and strategy/markups: active/passive measures, egress/brigade access, options/operating consequences; existing extent |
| S3 Performance design brief | PBDB/FEB: IDs/departures, verified requirements, methods/scenarios/criteria, inputs/limits; consultation and team/operator/certifier comment closure |
| S4 Analysis / FER | Analysis/calculations/models/sensitivity, draft/final FER/plans and limits; owned construction/system/commissioning/management requirements, acceptance/open items |
| S2 Early approval support (option) | Defined preliminary letter/report and bounded responses; partial-upgrade needs. Not final brief/FER or construction authority. The client opts in. |
| S5 Tender / integration (option) | Design-package review/closure and tender queries; D&C intent, contractor duties/substitution evidence; services design separate. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S6 Construction support (option) | Bounded RFIs, changes/shop interfaces, concealed-work hold points and evidence/departures; accepted-solution impacts. New solutions/staging separately authorised. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S7 Verification / occupation (option) | Evidence/test plan, certificates/scripts, accessible inspections/witnessing, defects/retests and scoped FEIR; unseen work/occupation dependencies; strategy/operations handover. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8a Specialist investigation (option) | Scheduled investigation/CFD/egress/heat-transfer questions: methods/scenarios/iterations, insured competence, access/evidence, acceptance/output; price individually. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8b Interim / staged strategy (option) | Phase/building/shutdown/occupation strategies; temporary measures, operator/contractor duties, impairment/restoration and acceptance dependencies. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S9a Defined advisory (option) | Defined question/cutoff/reliance, evidence limits, confidence/findings/actions/response end; continued design/novation duration/handover; annual operation separate. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S9b Independent peer review (option) | Independent review: named solutions/report, evidence cutoff, method/rounds; designer retains duty; advisory does not buy peer review. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Brief for scheduled solutions; FER for scheduled solutions; Smoke-control/cause-and-effect and selected services strategy review.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Interim strategies/shutdowns/staged occupation; each phase priced separately; Selected script review/test witnessing; evidence/defects/retests, trades close defects; Orders/defects: preserve evidence, diagnose extent, temporary controls, insured rectification designer/verifier and closure evidence; Independent peer review; designer retains duty.
Excluded: the party named does it: Sprinklers, hydrants, pumps, tanks and pipework design (fire-services designer, not yet engaged); Detection, alarm and warning design (fire-services or electrical designer, not yet engaged); Matrix design, controls programming and test execution (matrix designer, controls programmer and test contractors); Bushfire, legal/expert-witness and statutory BCA certification (bushfire adviser, legal/expert witness and statutory certifier).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Attached Project fire engineering agreement (attached), scope/fees, addenda and written acceptance govern; settle precedence/commencement. RFP does not authorise work.
- Written authority before scope/allowance/ceiling/rate/fee/program changes: reason, work, basis, time and solution/approval/occupation impacts.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; normal coordination/development and defined rounds included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Payment 30 days from correct milestone invoices. R6 declares inspection prepayment, release restrictions, interest/recovery/suspension or shorter terms; verify statutory requirements.
- State rates/hold period/escalation; extras/disbursements require prior authority.
- Validity 90 days from closing; ex GST/GST/total, base/options separate.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree team/authority/operator project/maintenance/future-use rights, third-party reliance, native models/licences/retention/handover. Confidentiality permits authorised/lawful disclosure; marketing needs consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notice/cure/suspension/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts. Insurance is not a cap; disclose conflicts, agree team changes.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equal solutions, methods/scenarios, rounds, authority/testing duties and resolved departures.
